notes: Full-size reversible-seat stroller, 23 lb, 50 lb max, from birth. Its signature selling point: car seat adapters for Clek, Maxi-Cosi, Nuna and Cybex are INCLUDED FREE (see adapter-guzzieguss-incl). US RETAIL GAP: the model appears discontinued at Guzzie+Guss (absent from their current 16-product Shopify catalog) and is 'Currently unavailable' on Amazon US; Albee Baby still lists it but its price is behind Cloudflare. Best confirmed price reference is Canadian (~CA$729.99 MSRP at TJ's Kids). Overall folded/unfolded inch dimensions are not published anywhere accessible — left null rather than guessed.
